en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Suleym Al Fara’a, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘It is befitting for the Momin that he does not die until he learns the Quran, or happens to be in its learning (process)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Sulaym al-Farra’ from a man from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
It is worthwhile for a Muslim to learn the Holy Quran before his death or should be in the process of learning.’”
